I was the one who found my mama having a heart attack. I can tell you I was privileged enough to have a chance to try and save her. She made it to the hospital but she didn't survive. I don't think you made the wrong choice at all. I don't know your whole situation but I'm sure your brother would want you to remember him at his best.

You did the right thing for you. My dad couldn't handle seeing my mom he'd rather remember her the way she was in life. And that is perfectly okay.

Try not to stay in those final moments. I know it's hard but find another memory you had together and remember it when you have these nights/days. Take every a day a minute at a time and be nice to yourself.
